page.layout: Top: running head with page number 514 at left and running title HABAKUK with CAP. III. at right. One column of text, full width. Continuing paragraph from the previous page, then centred heading "III. Argumentum huius carminis.", then the text of §. 1 running to the foot, and catchword "Christus" at lower right.

main_text.p: [?]sculum recipere, & inter caetera virorum Dei monumenta, ex Spiritus Sancti inspiratione conscripta, in domo Dei recondere: quippe dignum, ut in usum templi transeat, & ritualibus sacris concinna suâ nobilissimi argumenti pertractatione justo tempore respondeat.
main_text.head: III. Argumentum huius carminis.
main_text.p: §. 1. EX solo titulo seu inscriptione colligimus hoc carmen continere supplicationem, & ex primâ contentorum inspectione patet repraesentare pium animi, regnum Christi cupientis, desiderium ac votum, ad Deum delatum, quo petit ut expeditionem, ad regnum Christi per totum orbem promovendum aliquando suscipiendam, non aliter mirandâ suâ cooperatione secundet, ac olim factum est, quando populum Israëliticum in terram sanctam introduxit, atque in eâ possessione defendendo amplificavit. Tàm ampla sunt, quae ut imposterùm praestanda, hic in fide & cum certâ spe futuritionis petuntur; ut non possint nisi speratis in regno Messiae applicari: nihil enim eo tempore, quod inter captivitatem Babylonicam & Christi adventum intercessit, factum est, quod dici possit istis postulatis respondisse, eaque pro votorum magnitudine concepta desideria exhausisse. Magnum fuit Dei beneficium populi ex captivitate Babylonicâ liberatio, & ab Antiochi oppressione assertio; verùm non in illud mirabilium fastigium utraque illa populi è malis eductio assurgit, ut quae in hoc cantico commemorantur in eam cadere possint, aut cum illâ conferri: restat igitur, ut de illâ expeditione, quam ad haereditandum mundum faceret Christus

page.notes: Page number 514 and running head read clearly. The first word of the continuing paragraph is partly cut off at the left edge; "[?]sculum" is probably "saeculum" but is not certain. The heading carries a small printed ornament after "III." and after "carminis", which is not text and is left out. A middle dot appears between "ritualibus" and "sacris" in the continuing paragraph; it is printed as shown, not a hyphen at a line end. Stray dark marks in the left margin (a dot beside "regnum Christi" and one at the top left near the page number) are stains, not notes. The word "imposterùm" is printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s.
